nodes.label: Tag-driven Version Alignment
nodes.rationale: The package version is not maintained in package.json but derived at publish time from the pushed git tag (GITHUB_REF_NAME with the leading 'v' stripped), so a git tag is the single source of truth for release versions and no version-bump commits are needed.

nodes.label: Navigation Components (Sidebar, NavItem)
nodes.rationale: Navigation components are deliberately router-agnostic: instead of depending on react-router directly, they expose a renderLink prop so the consumer app injects its own link rendering, keeping the library decoupled from any specific routing solution.

nodes.label: theme.css Design Tokens
nodes.rationale: Design tokens (light/dark) are shipped as a theme.css consumed via Tailwind v4 @import, with class-based dark mode toggled by adding/removing the 'dark' class on <html>; the @source directive makes the consumer's Tailwind build generate utilities used inside the library's dist.
